newsitem.title: BELGIUM: City Hotels sees capital gains lifting 1997 result.
newsitem.headline: City Hotels sees capital gains lifting 1997 result.

text.p: Belgian hotels and leisure group City Hotels said on Monday 1997 results would be lifted by capital gains made on the sale of two U.S. hotels.

"Overall, the group's current results will experience a temporary fall in 1997 while hotel capacity in the U.S. is rebuilt. In contrast, the final results will be largely superior to their historical average, thanks to the capital gains on the sale of the (hotels) Doubletree and Hilton," City Hotels said in a statement on its provisional 1996 results.
The two hotels were sold in November last year for a capital gain of $20 million that will be booked in 1997, it said.
